newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING investment arm moderately optimistic.
newsitem.headline: ING investment arm moderately optimistic.

text.p: ING Groep NV (ING) said on Tuesday its ING Investment Management arm is moderately optimistic about markets for the remainder of 1997.
"After the strong price increases, the valuation on the equity market in the U.S. and Europe is currently at a fairly high level," the Dutch banking and insurance group said.
"In the long run, the climate for the equity markets is still favourable, considering the further possibilities for improvement in trade and industry.
"Long term interest rates are expected to remain more or less stable in most countries."
"For real estate investments, the forecast appears to be relatively positive," ING said.
The group earlier announced that ING Investment Management's assets under management grew more than 17 percent to 185.8 billion guilders in the first half of 1997.
